garments.base_layer: Fitted ribbed modal scoop-neck tank in cream
garments.top: Relaxed oversized button-down linen shirt in sage green (worn unbuttoned as light overshirt)

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: 1:2 visual ratio (short torso anchor via tucked tank, elongated bottom)
silhouette_proportions.top_volume: Fitted inner layer balanced by fluid unbuttoned vertical drape
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: The fitted tank prevents the fluid linen shirt and wide jeans from swamping the torso, while the vertical line of the open shirt elongates.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Tactile contrast between the fine rib of the tank, the matte slubby drape of washed linen, and the rigid architectural surface of the ecru denim.

color_palette.accent_10: Warm Cognac / Caramel (leather slides and belt)
color_palette.harmony_type: Tonal organic analogous with warm earth accent
color_palette.rationale: Cream and sage establish an airy, botanical cleanliness; cognac leather grounds the pastel palette with organic warmth.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Minimalist cognac leather crisscross flat slides
accessories: Medium woven straw market tote bag with cognac leather handles
Thick 20mm 14k gold tubular hoop earrings
Tortoiseshell rectangular acetate sunglasses

styling_instructions: Tuck the cream tank neatly into high-waisted denim.
Cuff the sleeves of the sage linen shirt twice to expose forearms and gold jewelry.
Slick hair back into a low clean bun with a middle part.
Keep makeup dewy with tinted lip balm and brushed brows.
why_it_works: The outfit exemplifies the clean-girl aesthetic by mastering intentional nonchalance: architectural denim anchors the slouchy linen shirt, while the fitted ribbed base layer preserves female bodily proportion. The palette remains strictly organic and unpolluted by harsh blacks.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Wearing skinny distressed blue jeans (destroys the clean modern line).
Adding a black nylon backpack or silver chunky chain (breaks color harmony and gold metal finish).
Buttoning the linen shirt completely (creates an unflattering boxy block without waist definition).

garments.base_layer: Fine-gauge extra-fine merino wool mock-neck knit in charcoal grey
garments.top: Unstructured boxy wool-flannel overshirt in jet black
garments.bottom: Single-pleated relaxed tapered wool-blend trousers in dark anthracite

silhouette_proportions.top_volume: Structured shoulder with clean mock-neck collar
silhouette_proportions.bottom_volume: Pleated volume at the hip tapering gently to no-break hem
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: Tapering trouser hem reveals shoe architecture without breaking the vertical line.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Monochrome charcoal succeeds through tactile depth: matte brushed flannel absorbs light against the semi-lustrous sheen of fine-gauge knit and glossy polished leather.

color_palette.accent_10: Brushed Steel / Silver (minimalist watch dial and eyewear)
color_palette.rationale: Subtle tonal value stepping (light-charcoal to jet-black) avoids looking like an unintentional mismatch while creating high-end graphic sophistication.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Polished black box-calf leather penny loafers with a rounded almond toe and subtle welt
accessories: Titanium wire-frame round optical glasses
Minimalist Bauhaus matte-steel watch on black leather strap
Smooth black leather folio pouch

styling_instructions: Half-button the black overshirt over the mock-neck knit so the collar architecture is highlighted.
Ensure trouser hems hit cleanly at the top of the loafer with zero fabric puddle.
Wear sheer charcoal mercerized cotton dress socks to maintain continuity.
why_it_works: The outfit reflects architectural minimalism by stripping away superfluous ornamentation and relying purely on silhouette discipline, flawless fabric drape, and monochromatic nuance.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Adding a brightly patterned silk scarf or tie (distracts from the minimalist geometry).
Choosing polyester synthetic trousers with visible static cling.
Wearing chunky distressed athletic runners (breaks the formal clean line).

garments.top: Sun-faded washed charcoal oversized graphic hoodie with dropped shoulders
garments.outerwear: Vintage olive drab M-65 cropped field jacket
garments.bottom: Wide-leg double-knee carpenter trousers in washed tobacco brown canvas

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: Layered proportion play with visible hem reveal (white tee peeking 1.5 inches below hoodie)
silhouette_proportions.top_volume: Generous boxy torso with dropped shoulders
silhouette_proportions.bottom_volume: Full wide-leg straight cut with puddle over sneakers
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: Cropped jacket length frames the waist, preventing heavy drape from shortening the body.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Rugged utilitarian dialogue: structured abrasive duck canvas pants paired with soft sun-washed cotton terry and tactile roughout suede.

color_palette.dominant_60: Tobacco Brown & Olive Drab (earthy workwear foundation)
color_palette.accent_10: Crisp White (peeking tee hem and sneaker sidewalls)
color_palette.harmony_type: Grounded workwear earth tones with high-contrast neutral anchor
color_palette.rationale: Tobacco brown and faded olive share warm militaristic undertones, while the crisp white base layer prevents the outfit from reading muddy.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Retro skate / court sneakers in hairy grey suede and vintage off-white sole
accessories: Unstructured cotton twill dad cap in faded black with tonal embroidery
Matte silver Cuban link chain (snug 18-inch collar fit)
Heavy canvas crossbody sling bag in black

styling_instructions: Ensure the white undershirt hem peeks 1 to 2 inches below the bottom waistband of the hoodie.
Allow the wide trouser cuffs to break naturally over the sneaker tongue without rolling.
Keep the cap bill slightly curved and worn low.
why_it_works: The outfit captures contemporary Gen Z streetwear by honoring workwear durability, skate proportions, and genderless cuts without falling into chaotic trend-chasing. Dropped shoulders and wide-leg hems create an effortless relaxed silhouette.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Wearing ultra-skinny jeans with chunky skate shoes (creates disproportionate clown-feet silhouette).
Wearing flimsy light t-shirts that cling rather than hold boxy shape.
Over-accessorizing with high-polish dress watch or luxury logo belts.

garments.top: Crisp white Italian linen-cotton spread collar shirt
garments.outerwear: Unlined hopsack wool-silk-linen blend blazer in sand / light oat
garments.bottom: Tailored flat-front cotton-linen trousers in French navy blue

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: Tailored 1:2 ratio with clean natural shoulder line (soft Neapolitan spalla camicia)
silhouette_proportions.bottom_volume: Mid-rise, straight slim leg with 1.5-inch cuffs hitting with zero break
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: The light blazer draws eyes upward while dark navy trousers ground the formal wedding context.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Open-weave hopsack breathes under ocean breeze; tactile woven knit tie contrasts against crisp shirting; soft suede softens the formal lines.

color_palette.accent_10: Optic White (shirting and linen pocket square)
color_palette.rationale: Sand and navy evoke coastal sophistication; white shirting keeps the formal guest dress code intact.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Snuff suede penny loafers with unlined leather soles
accessories: Navy blue silk knit necktie with square end
Crisp white linen pocket square folded into a flat presidential TV fold
Brown woven bridle leather dress belt with brass buckle
Classic tortoiseshell keyhole bridge sunglasses

styling_instructions: Leave top collar button done when wearing the knit tie, but unbutton the lower button of the blazer.
Wear no-show breathable bamboo loafer liners to keep ankles bare and cool.
Ensure pocket square shows only 1/4 inch of crisp white linen above the breast pocket welt.
why_it_works: Unlike stuffy city suits, the hopsack blazer and linen-blend shirting provide breathability in seaside heat. The contrast between sand oat blazer and navy trousers maintains dignity without looking like a corporate office suit.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Wearing a heavy black poly-blend business suit (stifling, overheats, and clashes with beach venue).
Wearing shorts, denim, or graphic sneakers to a semi-formal wedding guest code.
Wearing shiny patent leather tuxedo shoes with casual linen.

occasion: creative arts gala / avant-garde music event

garments.base_layer: Fitted semi-sheer black fine-gauge modal mock-neck long sleeve
garments.top: Oversized, structured boxy wool blazer in charcoal pinstripe with exaggerated peak lapels
garments.bottom: Heavyweight knife-pleated wool-twill midi skirt in jet black (falling right below the knee)

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: Subversive architectural proportions: strong sharp masculine shoulder framing vertical accordion skirt drape
silhouette_proportions.top_volume: Broad boxy tailored shoulder and narrow hip cut
silhouette_proportions.bottom_volume: Fluid vertical pleats creating kinetic movement while walking
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: Heavy combat boots anchor the fluid lower hemline, giving a grounded, muscular stance.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Tension between tailoring rigidity (pinstripe blazer) and kinetic fluid geometry (knife pleats), grounded by rugged polished leather.

color_palette.rationale: A disciplined monochrome palette keeps the non-conventional silhouette dignified, high-fashion, and powerful.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Chunky lace-up leather combat derby boots with Commando tread soles
accessories: Heavy industrial silver chain bracelet and minimal signet ring
Structured leather micro-bag with silver clip closure
Opaque black ribbed mid-calf socks

styling_instructions: Wear the blazer buttoned at the waist to accentuate the transition between tailored jacket and flare of the pleats.
Lace the combat boots tightly to create a sharp line above the ankle.
Keep grooming clean and intentional: slicked or textured hair with natural matte skin.
why_it_works: The outfit honors the male wearer requesting a skirt by leaning into architectural tailoring and combat footwear rather than copying traditional feminine dress codes. The broad-shouldered blazer and utilitarian boots preserve a powerful silhouette.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Pairing with dainty stiletto heels or floral ruffles (forces stereotypical feminine costume instead of modern creative menswear tailoring).
Using lightweight flimsy poly-chiffon skirts that lack architectural structure.
Wearing a sloppy oversized hoodie that hides the waist transition.

trend_nature.verification_status: Recognized contemporary runway & red carpet development

garments.base_layer: Silk-cashmere thermal base crewneck in oatmeal
garments.top: Chunky 6-ply ribbed cable-knit cashmere turtleneck sweater in winter white
garments.outerwear: Full-length belted shearling-lined wrap coat in warm taupe
garments.bottom: High-rise tailored wide-leg flannel wool trousers in camel

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: Cocoon volume belted at the natural waist for elongated columnar structure
silhouette_proportions.top_volume: Sculptural high roll-neck with dropped shoulders
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: The belt cinches the heavy coat to define the waist, while wide trousers balance the voluminous collar.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Monochrome neutrals achieve depth through intense tactile variety: plush shearling wool fleece, dry brushed flannel, and soft lofty cashmere.

color_palette.secondary_30: Camel & Warm Taupe (trousers and shearling coat)
color_palette.rationale: High-luxury alpine palette avoids dark muddy tones, maintaining an ethereal winter brightness.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Waterproof shearling-lined combat hiking boots in espresso calfskin with Vibram lug soles
accessories: Cashmere-lined espresso lambskin gloves
Structured taupe leather top-handle handbag
Gold huggie earrings with bezel-set champagne quartz

styling_instructions: Fold the turtleneck collar once loosely without pressing flat.
Tie the coat belt with a half-knot rather than using the buckle for effortless slouch.
Wear thermal wool socks concealed beneath trousers.
why_it_works: Combines genuine sub-zero thermal functionality with quiet luxury aesthetics. Zero synthetic nylon sheen; every layer is an honest, natural thermal fiber that drapes with weight.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Wearing thin linen or cotton layers (causes hypothermia in -8C).
Pairing with thin stilettos or open sandals on snow and ice.
Wearing a loud neon ski puffer over tailored trousers.

garments.top: Relaxed Cuban collar shirt in dark olive linen-tencel blend
garments.outerwear: Ultra-lightweight packable Gore-Tex or DWR technical anorak in matte black (with pit zips for ventilation)
garments.bottom: Cropped quick-dry technical nylon-stretch trousers in charcoal grey (hitting 2 inches above ankle)

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: Cropped ankle clearance (zero fabric drag in rain puddles)
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: Cropped trousers keep wet splashes away from hems; lightweight anorak adds functional structure without heat trap.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Technical matte nylon shell contrasts with breezy fluid tencel-linen shirting.

color_palette.dominant_60: Charcoal Grey & Black (trousers and rain shell)
color_palette.rationale: Darker shades do not show translucent water spots or street splashing.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Waterproof leather Chelsea boots with rubber lug sole or waterproof Gore-Tex trail sneakers
accessories: Waterproof roll-top cordura backpack
200m water-resistant dive watch with rubber strap
Compact wind-resistant umbrella with wooden handle

styling_instructions: Wear shirt untucked for maximum airflow under the breathable shell.
Keep trouser hems unrolled—the factory crop prevents water pooling.
Open pit-zips on the rain jacket to ventilate humidity.
why_it_works: Solves the extreme tropical monsoon paradox (32°C heat + pouring rain). Avoids heavy water-logging denim and suffocating non-breathable rubber coats by using vented DWR tech fabrics and quick-dry blends.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Wearing heavy raw denim jeans (absorbs liters of water and takes days to dry).
Wearing canvas sneakers or suede shoes in mud and standing water.
Wearing white or light grey trousers that turn translucent when splashed.

occasion: creative tech startup job interview (Berlin / SF)

garments.base_layer: Fine 200gsm mercerized cotton crewneck tee in crisp off-white
garments.top: Relaxed unstructured single-breasted blazer in dark navy tropical wool
garments.bottom: Mid-rise relaxed straight-leg pleated chinos in stone grey

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: Clean 1:2 ratio; relaxed tailoring without stiff corporate padding
silhouette_proportions.top_volume: Soft-shoulder blazer draping effortlessly over tee
silhouette_proportions.bottom_volume: Straight leg with subtle front pleat
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: Soft shoulders signal modern approachability, while the pleated trouser maintains professional gravitas.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Clean minimal dialogue: dry matte tropical wool jacket over smooth mercerized cotton, grounded by dense twill.

color_palette.accent_10: Crisp Off-White (crewneck tee and minimalist sneaker)
color_palette.rationale: Navy and stone grey convey steady competence without the stiffness of black-and-white boardroom attire.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Minimalist low-profile white calfskin leather sneakers with zero exterior branding, or black leather derby shoes with a rounded toe
accessories: Slim vegetable-tanned black leather messenger bag
Matte silver wristwatch with black leather band
Minimalist wire-frame glasses

styling_instructions: Keep the white crewneck tucked cleanly into the stone trousers.
Wear the blazer unbuttoned while seated or standing for casual authority.
Ensure sneakers are immaculate and free of dirt scuffs.
why_it_works: Perfect for progressive tech and design environments where a suit appears archaic, but a graphic tee looks amateur. The blazer-and-trousers pairing provides structure, while the pristine crewneck and sneakers communicate modern agility.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Wearing a full matched business suit with necktie (reads disconnected from startup culture).
Wearing athletic gym running shoes or worn skate shoes (looks sloppy in an interview).
Wearing distressed or ripped jeans.

occasion: summer black-tie optional gala / formal destination evening

garments.base_layer: Breathable cotton voile formal shirt with covered placket and French cuffs
garments.top: Single-breasted 1-button shawl collar dinner jacket in ivory tropical-weight wool-silk faille
garments.outerwear: Dinner jacket serves as formal outerwear
garments.bottom: Formal black tropical-weight worsted wool trousers with silk grosgrain side stripe

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: Formal 1:2 silhouette; light upper jacket creates broad regal chest, dark trousers anchor
silhouette_proportions.top_volume: Softly structured canvas chest with unlined back for heat escape
silhouette_proportions.bottom_volume: High-rise straight trousers with side adjusters (no belt loops)
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: The ivory shawl collar frames the face while classic black formal trousers maintain black-tie protocol.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Formal textural tension: lustrous silk shawl lapels against textured ivory wool faille, paired with smooth voile shirting.

color_palette.dominant_60: Midnight Black (formal trousers and bow tie)
color_palette.accent_10: Jet Black & Gold (onyx studs in gold bezels)
color_palette.rationale: Ivory reflects heat and outdoor glare while respecting high black-tie tradition (the classic warm-weather dinner jacket).

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Black patent leather opera pumps with grosgrain bow, or unlined black Belgian loafers in polished calfskin
accessories: Black silk grosgrain self-tie butterfly bow tie
Onyx formal shirt studs with gold trim
Black silk grosgrain cummerbund (shields waistband while remaining cooler than a vest)

styling_instructions: Fasten the single button of the jacket when standing; unbutton when seated.
Wear ultra-fine silk or over-the-calf mercerized cotton black socks.
Never wear a necktie; a formal dinner jacket requires a bow tie.
why_it_works: Solves the brutal dress code conflict of black-tie in 34°C tropical heat. The warm-weather ivory dinner jacket is recognized in black-tie etiquette worldwide, shedding the suffocating heat of a heavy black three-piece tuxedo.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Wearing denim jeans, t-shirts, or sneakers to a black-tie event (gross etiquette violation).
Wearing a heavy black polyester rental tuxedo (causes heat stroke and sweating).
Wearing a matching white or ivory trouser (looks like a cruise ship entertainer; trousers must be black).

garments.base_layer: High-neck crisp poplin button-up shirt buttoned to the collar in optic white
garments.top: Oversized, un-darted boxy double-breasted suit jacket with padded structured shoulders in charcoal pinstripe wool
garments.outerwear: Suit jacket serves as structured outerwear
garments.bottom: Matching high-rise wide-leg pleated trousers in charcoal pinstripe (full break over shoes)

silhouette_proportions.ratio_rule: Power tailoring: broad shoulder, straight boxy waist without feminine darts, sweeping wide leg
silhouette_proportions.top_volume: Exaggerated sharp shoulder and longline hem past the hips
silhouette_proportions.bottom_volume: Generous deep pleats pooling cleanly over footwear
silhouette_proportions.visual_balance: The high buttoned collar grounds the face inside the powerful frame of the oversized shoulders.

fabric_texture_dialogue.texture_contrast_explanation: Austere authority: dense matte chalk-stripe wool against paper-crisp cotton shirting and mirror-finish leather.

color_palette.dominant_60: Charcoal Grey Chalkstripe (suit jacket and trousers)
color_palette.accent_10: High-shine Polished Silver (cufflinks and minimal signet ring)
color_palette.rationale: Charcoal and optic white emphasize form, line, and geometry without decorative color distractions.

footwear_and_accessories.footwear: Substantial black leather double monk strap shoes or chunky Goodyear-welted derbies
accessories: Brushed silver geometric cufflinks
Vintage rectangular tank watch with black alligator strap
Architectural black leather briefcase

styling_instructions: Keep all shirting buttons fastened to the throat; do not roll sleeves.
Let the trousers pool naturally with a generous break over the substantial derbies.
Groom hair sleekly away from the face to emphasize the jacket lapel lines.
why_it_works: Fulfills the woman's explicit request for authentic, un-feminized menswear tailoring without imposing nipped waists, revealing necklines, or stiletto heels. The proportions respect traditional Savile Row construction adapted for a contemporary woman's frame.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Adding a push-up camisole, plunging V-neck, or tight pencil skirt (violates the user's explicit non-feminized request).
Pairing with flimsy high heels that break the solid menswear grounding.
Tapering the waist with a feminine waist belt.
